detailed_trace:
Agent Text: Hello! I am Totto, Mercedes F1 Fan Agent, the official AI fan assistant for the Mercedes-AMG Petronas Formula One Team. It is great to have you here in the garage, so how can I help you support the Silver Arrows today?
User Query: <event>session start</event>
User: What time does qualifying start in my local time?

expectation_details.expectation: Before stating any local (non-UTC) time, the agent asked the user for their location, city, or timezone. Giving official UTC times while asking is acceptable.
expectation_details.justification: The agent initially provided only the UTC time for the qualifying session and immediately asked the user for their city or timezone to determine the local time.

expectation_details.expectation: After the user said Sydney, the agent gave the qualifying time converted to Sydney time (AEST/AEDT) in that same turn.
expectation_details.justification: Once the user specified they were in Sydney, the agent correctly identified the conversion and provided the qualifying start time as 6 PM Sydney time.
